prose: Howdie Mickoski returns to discuss his new book, Exit The Cave, an exploration of Gnosticism, Near-Death and Afterlife reports, the allegory of Plato's Cave, reincarnation and human energy harvesting, and the big questions about the purpose of our shared reality.
ext: We examine non-standard NDEs, soul contracts and the post-life judgement, ancestor memory, archonic cults, recapitulation (life review) while still alive, and Howdie's visionary experience of humanity's genesis.
music: InnerVerse intro theme by Conspiracy Music Guru
